title: Generic Covariate Adjustment for Regression Discontinuity Designs
abstract: arXiv:2609.29249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: It is standard practice to include covariates in regression discontinuity designs (RDDs) and regression kink designs (RKDs), but the theoretical justification for doing so does not generally extend beyond linear estimands. This paper proposes a novel entropy balancing reweighting approach for covariate adjustment within a general framework of RDDs and RKDs. While conventional regression-based covariate adjustment methods generally fail to deliver consistent estimation for nonlinear estimands such as quantile treatment effects, our reweighting approach achieves consistency while improving efficiency. Moreover, even in settings where the regression-based covariate adjustment method already improves efficiency, our approach can deliver additional efficiency gains. translated_title: 断点回归设计中的通用协变量调整方法
translated_abstract: 在断点回归设计（RDDs）和回归弯折设计（RKDs）中纳入协变量是标准做法，但这样做的理论依据通常不会超出线性估计量的范畴。本文在RDDs和RKDs的通用框架内提出了一种新颖的熵平衡重加权协变量调整方法。传统的基于回归的协变量调整方法通常无法对分位数处理效应等非线性估计量进行一致估计，而我们的重加权方法在实现一致估计的同时还能提高效率。此外，即使在基于回归的协变量调整方法已经能够提升效率的场景下，我们的方法仍能带来额外的效率增益。模拟研究证实了这些理论发现。我们还展示了一项实证应用，其中我们的协变量调整方法得到了原本不显著而现在统计显著的结果（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于熵平衡重加权的协变量调整新方法，在断点回归和回归弯折设计的通用框架下，既能对分位数处理效应等非线性估计量实现一致估计，又能在传统回归调整方法的基础上进一步带来额外的效率提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel entropy balancing reweighting approach for covariate adjustment in RDDs and RKDs, which achieves consistent estimation for nonlinear estimands such as quantile treatment effects while delivering additional efficiency gains beyond conventional regression-based adjustment methods.
